<START>
Let's think step by step.

Identify the error in the following translation from German to English. The error will be one of the following types: Named Entities (entities like names, places, locations are changed), Numerical Values (numbers, dates, units are changed), Modifiers or Adjectives (modifiers and adjectives related to a noun are changed), Negation or Antonyms (negations or comparatives are changed to their antonyms), Facts (trivial factual errors not related to the above), or Dropped Content (a significant clause is removed). 

Source: In der Liste der Baudenkmale in Lenzen (Elbe) sind alle Baudenkmale der brandenburgischen Stadt Lenzen (Elbe) und ihrer Ortsteile aufgelistet.
Translation: In the list of architectural monuments in Lenzen all architectural monuments of the Brandenburg city of Lenzen and its districts are listed.

Identify the error type. Options:
(A) Modifiers or Adjectives
(B) Numerical Values
(C) Negation or Antonyms
(D) Named Entities
(E) Dropped Content
(F) Facts
<ANS_START>(D)<ANS_END>
<END>
